answer: Each identity must lock a unique marble bond and grow a bridge of signatures from five distinct established peers before it can receive rewards. Every epoch the bridge must be re-attested with a quartz-hardness VDF that requires a fixed 10-minute sequential delay on ordinary hardware. An attacker who wants a thousand clones must either bribe or compromise five peers per clone or run a thousand parallel VDF machines for the full delay, both of which cost more than the epoch emission, while honest agents pay the VDF once and keep their marble bond.
